title: What are fake banks?
body:
What are fake banks?

A fake bank is a site that looks like a real bank, but it's a fake!

How to tell:
• Real bank: sberbank.ru
• Fake: sberbank-check.ru (with a hyphen and different ending)

Scammers copy the design of a real bank, but it's a deception!

✅ ALADDIN checks the site address and warns: "This is NOT a real bank!"
